title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Portuguese Teacher
description:
At Qubika, we design, develop, and deploy custom software solutions for organizations that are making an impact through technology.


We are currently looking for a Portuguese Teacher based in Brazil to join our In-House Teacher Team and support our professionals in their language development journey.


This role is ideal for someone passionate about teaching adults in corporate environments, who enjoys creating dynamic and goal-oriented virtual classes.


What we expect from you:


  • Minimum of 3 years of experience teaching Portuguese to adults or foreign learners
  • Teaching certification (Language Teaching or Foreign Language Teaching). If you have +3 years of experience in language institutes, certification is a plus but not mandatory
  • Experience teaching in corporate or professional contexts
  • Ability to plan objective-based lessons and adapt them to different proficiency levels
  • Experience working with CEFR levels (A1–C1/C2)
  • Strong experience with online teaching tools (Zoom, Google Meet, shared docs, presentations, digital whiteboards, etc.)
  • Experience assessing and tracking student progress
  • Strong asynchronous communication skills (Slack, email, other platforms)
  • Excellent time management and punctuality in virtual classes
  • High level of autonomy and organization


What we offer


  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.


This job opening includes people registered in the National Registry for Persons with Disabilities (Registro Nacional de Personas con Discapacidad - Ley N° 19.691) who meet the conditions and suitability for the position. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at .

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Structural Design Engineer
description:
Structural Design Engineer (Tekla Structures)

Crewit Resourcing is hiring in Ireland!

We are seeking a highly skilled Structural Design Engineer with extensive experience in Tekla Structures to join our engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design, and 3D modeling of steel and/or reinforced concrete structures, ensuring compliance with applicable codes and project specifications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform structural analysis and design of steel and reinforced concrete structures
  • Develop detailed 3D structural models using Tekla Structures
  • Design steel connections (bolted and welded)
  • Prepare GA drawings, shop drawings, and fabrication details
  • Coordinate with architects, MEP teams, and contractors
  • Review fabrication drawings and ensure constructability
  • Conduct material take-offs and quantity estimation
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant building codes and standards
  • Provide technical support during fabrication and construction stages


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering
  • 3–8+ years of experience in structural steel design
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Tekla Structures
  • Strong understanding of structural analysis and load calculations
  • Experience with structural software (ETABS, SAP2000, STAAD, etc.)
  • Knowledge of international design codes (AISC, Eurocode, BS, etc.)
  • Strong communication and coordination skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial or high-rise steel structures
  • Knowledge of BIM workflows and clash detection
  • Experience working with fabrication teams
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license (if applicable)

title: Portuguese Teacher
description:
At Qubika, we design, develop, and deploy custom software solutions for organizations that are making an impact through technology.


We are currently looking for a Portuguese Teacher based in Brazil to join our In-House Teacher Team and support our professionals in their language development journey.


This role is ideal for someone passionate about teaching adults in corporate environments, who enjoys creating dynamic and goal-oriented virtual classes.


What we expect from you:


  • Minimum of 3 years of experience teaching Portuguese to adults or foreign learners
  • Teaching certification (Language Teaching or Foreign Language Teaching). If you have +3 years of experience in language institutes, certification is a plus but not mandatory
  • Experience teaching in corporate or professional contexts
  • Ability to plan objective-based lessons and adapt them to different proficiency levels
  • Experience working with CEFR levels (A1–C1/C2)
  • Strong experience with online teaching tools (Zoom, Google Meet, shared docs, presentations, digital whiteboards, etc.)
  • Experience assessing and tracking student progress
  • Strong asynchronous communication skills (Slack, email, other platforms)
  • Excellent time management and punctuality in virtual classes
  • High level of autonomy and organization


What we offer


  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.


This job opening includes people registered in the National Registry for Persons with Disabilities (Registro Nacional de Personas con Discapacidad - Ley N° 19.691) who meet the conditions and suitability for the position. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at .

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Consultor SAP FI - Inglês Avançado
description:
Nós nos transformamos. Soluções SAP® em Valor


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:


  • Atuação como Consultor(a) FI em nosso time de projetos internacionais.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor(a) SAP FI a mais de 5 anos;
  • Atuação em projetos de implementação do S/4 HANA;
  • Atuação remota;
  • Inglês avançado - Obrigatório.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Representante de Propaganda Médica
description:
Na Exeltis, acreditamos no poder da conexão e do conhecimento para transformar vidas.


Estamos em busca de Representante de Propaganda Médica com paixão por impactar positivamente a jornada das pacientes, por meio de um relacionamento próximo com médicos e farmácias.

Se você tem energia, atitude protagonista, foco em resultados e deseja crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, essa oportunidade é para você!


Local de atuação: Passo Fundo - RS


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar visitas médicas e em pontos de venda (PDVs) de forma estratégica, promovendo nosso portfólio com excelência.
  • Gerir o painel médico e farmacêutico, mantendo o cadastro sempre atualizado, com foco na geração de demanda qualificada.
  • Planejar roteiros de visita com base em metas e indicadores de performance.
  • Monitorar os resultados das ações em campo e propor estratégias para superação de metas.
  • Organizar e participar de eventos, treinamentos e ações promocionais com médicos e farmácias.
  • Controlar e distribuir amostras grátis de maneira responsável e conforme as normas internas.
  • Realizar lançamentos em sistema e relatórios de visita, contribuindo para a inteligência de mercado.
  • Garantir a presença e a visibilidade dos produtos nos pontos de venda da sua região.
  • Aplicar as estratégias da empresa com base em sólido conhecimento técnico e habilidades de vendas.


Requisitos para brilhar nessa vaga:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • CNH B ativa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Pacote Office em nível intermediário.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico.
  • Residir em: Passo Fundo/RS


Você vai arrasar se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à saúde ou gestão.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico com foco em saúde feminina .
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de demanda e relacionamento.


Habilidades que fazem a diferença:

  • Foco em resultados, com forte orientação para metas.
  • Excelente comunicação e poder de argumentação.
  • Organização, disciplina e proatividade.
  • Capacidade de análise de dados e identificação de oportunidades.
  • Espírito de equipe e colaboração.


Se identificou? Venha fazer parte da Família Sangue Azul!

title: Portuguese Teacher
description:
At Qubika, we design, develop, and deploy custom software solutions for organizations that are making an impact through technology.


We are currently looking for a Portuguese Teacher based in Brazil to join our In-House Teacher Team and support our professionals in their language development journey.


This role is ideal for someone passionate about teaching adults in corporate environments, who enjoys creating dynamic and goal-oriented virtual classes.


What we expect from you:


  • Minimum of 3 years of experience teaching Portuguese to adults or foreign learners
  • Teaching certification (Language Teaching or Foreign Language Teaching). If you have +3 years of experience in language institutes, certification is a plus but not mandatory
  • Experience teaching in corporate or professional contexts
  • Ability to plan objective-based lessons and adapt them to different proficiency levels
  • Experience working with CEFR levels (A1–C1/C2)
  • Strong experience with online teaching tools (Zoom, Google Meet, shared docs, presentations, digital whiteboards, etc.)
  • Experience assessing and tracking student progress
  • Strong asynchronous communication skills (Slack, email, other platforms)
  • Excellent time management and punctuality in virtual classes
  • High level of autonomy and organization


What we offer


  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.


This job opening includes people registered in the National Registry for Persons with Disabilities (Registro Nacional de Personas con Discapacidad - Ley N° 19.691) who meet the conditions and suitability for the position. If you require any accommodations during the application process, please reach out to us at .

title: Encarregado de Turno
description:
Como Encarregado de Turno , você apoiará a equipe da Produção, auxiliando na gestão do time e das rotinas produtivas, incluindo:


Principais atividades

  • Revisar e implementar instruções de trabalho e processos
  • Garantir treinamento da equipe
  • Gerenciar rotinas de produção (planejamento de produção, identificar e eliminar gargalos, etc.)
  • Analisar indicadores de produção
  • Garantir o seguimento correto dos fluxos produtivos


Nessa função você ficará alocado em nossa unidade fabril de Itupeva-SP , em horário de turno rotativo.


Perfil desejado

Para ter sucesso nesta função, você precisará de:

  • Ensino Médio completo – desejável cursando superior
  • 2 anos experiência com gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência em indústria química ou de alimentos
  • Conhecimento sistema ERP e MS Office
  • Conhecimento em processos de auditoria
  • Conhecer PDCA e ferramentas Lean


O que você ganha com isso?

Com muitas oportunidades de desenvolvimento, você fará parte de uma equipe altamente competente e de uma empresa internacional que está em rápido crescimento que coloca a segurança e a sustentabilidade em primeiro lugar.

title: Engenharia de Software Sênior (Afirmativa para Mulheres)
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.


Como engenheiro(a) de software, você será parte fundamental na construção, evolução e operação das soluções tecnolgicas que impulsionam os produtos e jornadas do Itaú. Seu papel envolve contribuir ativamente em todas as fases da entrega, trazendo qualidade, colaboração e mentalidade de crescimento contínuo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Engenharia de Software Sênior , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Você irá atuar na nossa plataforma de limites, focado na expansão, evolução e gamificação de nossos programas de limites para clientes PF, nos auxiliando a estreitar nossas relações entre cliente e banco.


Nessa função você vai:

  • Participar das cerimônias do time (daily, planning, refinamentos), contribuindo para alinhamento e tomada de decisões.
  • Desenvolver funcionalidades ponta a ponta: análise, codificação, testes, documentação e implantação.
  • Colaborar em revisões técnicas e code reviews, ajudando a manter o padrão de engenharia da squad.
  • Atuar na investigação de incidentes, melhoria contínua e sustentação dos sistemas em produção.
  • Garantir observabilidade, qualidade e manutenção saudável das aplicações, contribuindo para detecção proativa de problemas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com produto, design, QA, dados e outras especialidades para entregar valor continuamente.


No que você precisa mandar bem?

  • Experiência avançada em Java e/ou Kotlin
  • Conhecimento avançado em serviços da AWS (EKS, EC2, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, Kafka, API Gateway)
  • Conhecimento de construções de system design
  • Certificação AWS é desejável


Ao se tornar um(a) ituber você tem

  • Vale-Transporte
  • Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)
  • Plano odontológico (Odontoprev ou Interodonto)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
  • Previdência privada
  • Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
  • Incentivo a estudos
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass
  • Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
  • + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Advogado(a) Pleno (Foco em Direito Imobiliário)
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital.


Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala; 1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente; 23.000 pontos de distribuição; mais de 400.000 colaboradores. Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo.


Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!


Posição: Advogado(a) Pleno


Descrição da posição:

  • Elaboração, revisão e negociação de contratos imobiliários;
  • Condução de due diligence imobiliária e análise de riscos jurídicos;
  • Atuação em processos administrativos e judiciais tributários;
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e acompanhamento de prazos;
  • Estruturação e revisão de planejamentos tributários relacionados a operações imobiliárias;
  • Consultoria jurídica preventiva para as áreas internas e clientes;
  • Análise de viabilidade jurídica e tributária de novos negócios;
  • Interação com cartórios, órgãos públicos e fiscais;
  • Apoio em operações societárias com impacto imobiliário e tributário;
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • OAB ativa;
  • Conhecimento em processo civil aplicado ao contencioso tributário, legislação municipal, estadual e federal aplicável, direito Imobiliário (compra e venda, locação, incorporação imobiliária, loteamentos, regularização de imóveis, due diligence imobiliária), direito Tributário (tributação direta e indireta, planejamento tributário, contencioso administrativo e judicial), tributos incidentes sobre operações imobiliárias (ITBI, ITCMD, IPTU, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS, entre outros). Estruturação societária com foco imobiliário e tributário, análise e elaboração de contratos imobiliários, procedimentos de registros públicos (cartórios de imóveis);
  • Noções de contabilidade e análise de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Pacote Office (especialmente Excel) e sistemas jurídicos;
  • Experiência com empresas do setor imobiliário, holdings patrimoniais ou incorporadoras é um diferencial!


Local: Berrini, Zona Sul de São Paulo;

Modelo: 100% presencial;

Contrato: CLT.


Benefícios:

  • VT;
  • VR;
  • VA;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Assistência Médica Amil;
  • Assistência Odontológica Amil;
  • Day Off;
  • Totalpass;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR.


A J&T Express Brasil é uma empregadora que oferece oportunidades Iguais e não discrimina no recrutamento, contratação, treinamento, promoção ou qualquer outra prática de emprego por motivos de raça, cor, religião, gênero, origem nacional, idade, orientação sexual, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra condição legalmente protegida.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior PHP (Symfony)/Oracle

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Assistente de Equipamentos (Exclusivo para PCDs)
description:
O Assistente de Equipamentos será responsável por apoiar diretamente os Coordenadores na execução das atividades operacionais da área, garantindo controle, rastreabilidade e integridade dos assets. Este profissional atuará no inventário físico, recebimento e identificação de equipamentos, atualização de sistemas, preservação, movimentação segura e preparação de materiais para Workshop e embarques offshore. É uma função essencial para assegurar organização, conformidade técnica e fluxo eficiente dos equipamentos no ciclo operacional.


Atividades:

  • Realizar o inventário físico dos assets, garantindo rastreabilidade, identificação correta e acurácia nos sistemas URSA e PeopleSoft.
  • Atuar como suporte operacional direto aos Coordenadores, assegurando execução, acompanhamento e controle das atividades na área de equipamentos.
  • Realizar conferências visuais e assessments básicos dos equipamentos recebidos de offshore ou fornecedores, registrando evidências conforme padrões internos.
  • Suportar o processo de recebimento junto ao SCM, incluindo triagem, conferência de documentação e atualizações sistêmicas.
  • Identificar equipamentos com etiquetas multicoloridas conforme padrões definidos para status, prioridade e fluxo operacional.
  • Garantir a preservação e o acondicionamento corretos dos equipamentos.
  • Atualizar status, localização e informações técnicas dos assets nos sistemas internos, assegurando confiabilidade dos dados para operação e planejamento.
  • Realizar movimentações seguras de equipamentos em pátio, racks e áreas de estoque, mantendo organização e práticas de 6S.
  • Apoiar na preparação de equipamentos para envio ao Workshop, incluindo embalagem, registro e documentação.
  • Acompanhar o retorno de equipamentos do Workshop, realizando conferência física e sistêmica e reportando eventuais desvios.
  • Suportar a preparação de equipamentos para embarques offshore, garantindo conformidade com requisitos técnicos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Reportar desvios operacionais, anomalias técnicas e inconsistências de inventário aos Coordenadores de forma tempestiva.
  • Cumprir normas e diretrizes de segurança, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho organizado e disciplinado.


Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Formação Técnica Completa nas áreas de Mecânica, Eletrônica, Automação, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas (obrigatório).
  • Desejável Ensino Superior em Administração, Engenharia e/ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas e componentes relacionados a ROV, Survey ou Tooling (desejável).
  • Noções de leitura de desenhos técnicos e uso básico de instrumentos de medição.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em controle de inventário, logística ou áreas operacionais.
  • Proficiência no pacote Microsoft Office.


Essa oportunidade é exclusiva para profissionais com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas pelo INSS.
